newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian plane hijacked on domestic flight.
newsitem.headline: Indian plane hijacked on domestic flight.

text.p: An Indian airplane on a domestic flight between the capital New Delhi and the northern city of Jammu was hijacked on Thursday, an airline official said.
The official, who asked not to be identified, said Alliance Air flight 421A left New Delhi at 3:15 p.m. (0945 GMT) for Jammu, winter capital of Jammu and Kashmir state.
"It was hijacked," the official told Reuters by telephone.
He said the plane had not landed. Alliance Air is a subsidiary of state-owned Indian Airlines.
The Press Trust of India said there were 36 passengers on the plane.
